name: Hash check
summary: SHA hash of text, check expected hash
author: friday-core
description: Computes the SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 hash of pasted text (UTF-8) with the platform's own crypto and compares it with a hash someone published, naming a length mismatch (64 hex characters is SHA-256). It never reads a file; for a download it says how to hash the file in PowerShell (Get-FileHash). MD5 is not offered.
